areas.name: Route and Save Setup
areas.location_cue: The Windows launcher, Complete Edition add-on list, local save folder, and opening bunker.
areas.note: Atomfall is absent from games.json. Researched route: native Windows PC Complete Edition, including Wicked Isle, The Red Strain, and both supply bundles; no secondary-exclusive route or emulation branch is currently documented.

levels.1: Confirm every permanent add-on before creating the completion save.
levels.2: Install the Windows PC base game, Wicked Isle, The Red Strain, Basic Supply Bundle, and Enhanced Supply Bundle.
levels.3: Use the native Windows Complete Edition, update the game, and verify both story expansions plus both supply bundles are enabled. Start a new save only after the add-on list is complete; no current platform-exclusive gameplay requires a secondary or emulated route.

levels.1: Protect the profile before conversations, skill spending, and expansion travel.
levels.2: Close the game and locate %LOCALAPPDATA%\Atomfall\PC_ProfileSaves.
levels.3: Exit to desktop, open %LOCALAPPDATA%\Atomfall\PC_ProfileSaves, copy the entire user-ID folder to a dated location outside the game directory, and retain multiple milestone copies. Never overwrite the only pre-choice backup with a later cloud sync.

areas.name: Central Choice Hub
areas.location_cue: The underground control room, surrounding dig chamber, extractor, fluid system, and routes back to the surface.
areas.note: SAVE-BACKUP: this is the master route split. Earlier dam-terminal and character-location backups are also required. Each completion closes the active save; restore afterward.

save_backup.title: Create a master branch backup now
save_backup.why: Terminal commands, sample handovers, and central controls permanently select incompatible routes.
save_backup.when: Before the dam command where possible, and again before using any central extractor, fluid, or self-destruct control.

point_of_no_return.title: Central controls commit the current route
point_of_no_return.warning: Complete one prepared route, record it, then restore the appropriate backup before touching another control.

levels.1: Several prepared routes diverge at terminals, item handovers, and the central chamber.
levels.2: Keep every route alive, carry the required samples and tools, then back up before entering the central dig-site decision sequence.
levels.3: Close the game before the final physical action and copy %LOCALAPPDATA%\Atomfall\PC_ProfileSaves to a dated master folder. Keep separate earlier backups before the dam terminal and before revealing one researcher's location, because those choices oppose other routes.

levels.1: The first telephone chain remains viable after the underground complex is fully powered.
levels.2: Power all four data stores, redirect their signals, open the central route, and prepare the four marked failsafe charges.
levels.3: Arm all four large failsafe charges around the central object, pull the self-destruct control, return to the Interchange, answer the telephone beside the pneumatic tube, then leave through Slatten Dale and enter the original bunker. Restore the master backup afterward.

levels.1: Build trust in the village hall before handling the prison and cave objectives.
levels.2: Complete the village-hall task chain first. The required radio component is inside Speaking Cave; keep it available for this branch.
levels.3: Report the church investigation, obtain authorized prison access, question the prisoner, return to the village hall without admitting an incompatible action, and deliver the Protocol Radio Part. At the central site, arm all four failsafes and use self-destruct; leave through Skethermoor and reach the marked landing point near the prison.

levels.1: A hidden church workroom and an operating-theatre sample prepare this branch.
levels.2: Retrieve the cellar key from Medical, bring Sample One from the operating theatre to the cellar researcher, and preserve the modified canister.
levels.3: If the prison researcher was freed, disclose that location only on this restored branch, then collect Poisoned Sample One. At the central site, open both yellow fire-safety valves, insert the canister into the fluid input outside the control room, and pull the Fire Safety System lever. Return through the Slatten Dale entrance, cross the Medical tunnels, and meet at the marked tunnel exit.

levels.1: Keep the freed prison researcher and the dam data branch intact.
levels.2: Recover the Robotics research notes, run GEN ERA at the dam store, and prepare two spare atomic batteries for the extractor.
levels.3: Preserve the prison rescue and return the Robotics notes before selecting GEN ERA at Casterfell Dam. Supply both batteries to the central extractor, activate its console, and take the produced sample back to the Robotics office. Keep the researcher's location private on this branch.

levels.1: Activate the regional radio towers and preserve the alternate dam command.
levels.2: Complete the three radio-tower activations, run GEN MOVE at the dam store, and retain both its tape and a central sample.
levels.3: Activate the three requested radio towers, use GEN MOVE at Casterfell Dam, take the produced tape, and report back. At the central site, power the extractor with two atomic batteries and take a sample before using the four failsafes and self-destruct. Follow the post-event audio direction to the marked Casterfell extraction point with the sample still carried.

levels.1: A book, cave offering, and Medical-tunnel canister prepare this branch.
levels.2: Finish the old-mine requests, collect the Growth Stimulant beyond the infected Medical tunnels, and keep it for the central fluid system.
levels.3: Return the requested book, complete the Speaking Cave offering without choosing the hostile dialogue, and recover the Growth Stimulant beside the scientist in the deep Medical tunnels. At the central site, open both yellow fire-safety valves, load the stimulant into the fluid input, pull the Fire Safety System lever, then follow the restored branch's marked exit.

items.label: Let a reprogrammed robot defeat five enemies

levels.1: The Synaptics skill turns one disabled machine into a temporary ally.
levels.2: Unlock Puppeteer, reprogram a compatible robot, and let that ally deliver five final hits.
levels.3: Read the Puppeteer Manual, buy the skill, disable rather than destroy a robot, reprogram it, and draw living enemies into its firing lane. It must supply five finishing blows; repeat with another robot if it is destroyed early.

items.label: Destroy three robots with salvaged heavy weapons

levels.1: A Synaptics manual permits carrying weapons torn from disabled machines.
levels.2: Unlock Salvage Robotics, remove a heavy weapon from a destroyed robot, and use salvaged weapons to destroy three robots.
levels.3: Read the Salvage Robotics Manual, purchase the skill, destroy a heavy robot, detach its weapon, and use that limited-ammunition weapon for the final damage on three robots. Salvage another wreck if the first gun empties.

items.label: Affect six enemies with red mist in a short window

levels.1: Gather a group before throwing the first crafted bomb.
levels.2: Use one or more Red Mist Bombs to affect six living enemies in rapid succession.
levels.3: Craft at least two bombs, draw six enemies into one compact area, throw the first into the centre, and immediately cover stragglers with the second. Save beforehand so materials can be restored if the timing window expires.

items.label: Defeat three enemies bare-handed while adaptation is active

levels.1: The Organics formula activates only while the red contamination state is present.
levels.2: Unlock Red Strain Adaptation, become contaminated, and finish three enemies with unarmed attacks before the state clears.
levels.3: Read the Organics formula, spend four stimulants, carry healing, deliberately enter a controlled red-contamination source, unequip weapons, and make fists deliver three final hits while the adaptation icon remains active.

items.label: Win a fistfight against a contaminated human

levels.1: Isolate one human-shaped infected target before putting weapons away.
levels.2: Defeat one contaminated human using only unarmed attacks.
levels.3: Separate a contaminated human from nearby threats, unequip every weapon and throwable, then use kicks, dodges, and punches until the unarmed final hit lands. Damage from an ally, trap, or weapon can invalidate the clean attempt.

levels.1: Two recovered candidates compete for one final Command Centre position.
levels.2: Reach permission level four, recover both final brain jars, unlock the central base-game route, then copy the save before filling the fifth slot.
levels.3: Load the four shared jars, collect both remaining jars without installing either, and ensure the central dig site is accessible. Close the game and copy %LOCALAPPDATA%\Atomfall\PC_ProfileSaves; installing either candidate immediately blocks the other route.

levels.1: One fifth-slot candidate directs you toward the radome controls.
levels.2: Install the green fifth-slot jar, accept its directive, and realign the radio antenna array in Radome Three.
levels.3: From the level-four backup, recover the green jar from the train-yard turntable building around 34.7E, 60.9N and install it fifth. Accept the directive, use level-five clearance in Flight Engineering, enter Radio Communications, climb Radome Three, and pull the orange alignment control. Complete the requested central-site action, then return for the final command lever.

levels.1: The other fifth-slot candidate is recalled from classified storage.
levels.2: Recall the red fifth-slot jar from the Interchange tube, install it, and complete the launch-site power sequence.
levels.3: Restore the level-four backup, use the Interchange tube terminal to Recall Classified Storage, take the red jar, and install it fifth. Follow the resulting launch-site power instructions, obtain and deliver the requested central sample, then return to the research command route and complete its final control sequence.
